title: Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand — Cancellation, Refund and No-Show Terms
content:
**Conditions of carriage, schedule of cancellation terms.** For each fare brand of Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand, the table sets whether an unflown ticket may be cancelled for a flight credit, the latest point for doing so, the cancellation fee retained from the ticket value, whether a voluntary cancellation is refunded to the original form of payment, refund processing times, and what happens to unflown value on a no-show.

## Cancellation for credit

| Fare brand | Cancel for credit | Cutoff before first unflown departure (elapsed hours) | Cancellation fee, domestic (USD) | Cancellation fee, short-haul international (USD) | Cancellation fee, long-haul international (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | Permitted | 1 | 99 | 149 | 199 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | Permitted | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Main Plus | Permitted | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Permitted | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | Permitted | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Crestline First | Permitted | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

## Refundability, refund processing and no-shows

| Fare brand | Voluntary cancellation refunded to original payment | Card refunds processed within (business days) | Other refunds processed within (calendar days) | Unflown value on a no-show |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | No | 7 | 20 | Forfeited in full |
| Crestline Main Cabin | No | 7 | 20 | Forfeited in full |
| Crestline Main Plus | No | 7 | 20 | Forfeited in full |
| Crestline Main Flexible | Yes (refundable) | 7 | 20 | Retained on the ticket |
| Crestline Premium Economy | No | 7 | 20 | Forfeited in full |
| Crestline First | Yes (refundable) | 7 | 20 | Retained on the ticket |

## Reading the schedule

- A cancellation fee is charged only on Crestline Basic Economy, and its amount follows the itinerary class of the ticket: 99 dollars domestic, 149 dollars short-haul international, 199 dollars long-haul international.
- Crestline Main Flexible and Crestline First are the refundable brands; the other four are nonrefundable.
- "Forfeited in full" means the entire unflown value is forfeited when the passenger is a no-show; "retained on the ticket" means the unflown value stays on the ticket.
- The processing times are the same on every brand: 7 business days to a credit or debit card and 20 calendar days to any other form of payment.
